A curated, extensible collection of JavaScript agent parameterizations for the [BITE module](../index.qmd) in iLand. Browse existing agents by taxonomic group or keyword, inspect their ecological parameterization, and download or copy the scripts for your own simulations.

::: {#zoo-listing}
:::

---

## Contributing an Agent

BITE Zoo entries live centrally in the iLand Git repository under `docs/bite/zoo/<agent-slug>/` and are automatically discovered when the site is rendered.

1. Copy [`docs/bite/zoo/_template/`](https://github.com/edfm-tum/iland-model/tree/master/docs/bite/zoo/_template) to a new folder named after your agent (lowercase, hyphen-separated).
2. Add your JavaScript agent file (e.g., `my_agent.js`) and an optional thumbnail image (`thumb.jpg` or `thumb.png`).
3. Fill in `index.qmd` (YAML metadata, ecological background, references, and the `file="my_agent.js"` code block).
4. Open a pull request on [GitHub](https://github.com/edfm-tum/iland-model) — no manual edits to `index.qmd` or `_quarto.yml` are required.
